title: Yoniso
text: 2. -yad idaṃ yonisomanasikārasampadā || || 3. Yonisomanasikārasampannassetam bhikkhave bhikkhun opātikaṅkham ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāvessati a- a- maggam bahulīkarissati || || Kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu yonisomanasikārasampanno ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bahulīkaroti [page 034] 34 Magga-Samyuttam XLV. Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti || pe || sammāsamadhim bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || || Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu yonisomanasikārasampanno ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāveti a- a- maggam bahulīkarotī ti || || II.
